h: Bruno Mars announces death of his father
p: Singer Bruno Mars has announced the death of his father, Peter Hernandez, sharing a black-and-white photo of them embracing in a hospital bed and calling him his greatest teacher.
body: American singer Bruno Mars is mourning the death of his father, Peter Hernandez.
The singer shared the news in an emotional Instagram post, describing his father as his greatest teacher. He posted a black-and-white photo of himself hugging his father in a hospital bed.
He said he had the chance to hug his father one last time the week before, and credited him with shaping his life and career.
Bruno Mars, whose real name is Peter Gene Hernandez, is among the nominees for the 2027 Grammy Awards.
